new_entities.name: Essential amino acid supplementation
new_entities.description: Supplementation with all essential amino acids around or after exercise.

new_entities.name: Post-exercise muscle protein synthesis
new_entities.description: The rate of skeletal muscle protein synthesis during recovery after exercise.

edges.effect_quant: Leucine-enriched EAA increased post-exercise muscle protein synthesis by about 33% compared with a lower-leucine EAA formulation, but newer energy-deficit trials suggest that very high EAA doses improve whole-body protein balance more reliably than they further increase mixed-muscle protein synthesis.
edges.population: healthy adults recovering from resistance or endurance exercise
edges.mechanism: Essential amino acids, especially leucine, provide both the substrate and anabolic signaling needed to activate post-exercise muscle protein synthesis. The response seems real, but once a sufficient dose threshold is reached, adding still more EAA may help whole-body balance more than it boosts measured muscle protein synthesis itself.
edges.summary: This is a solid anabolic edge, but the nuance matters. EAA ingestion after exercise supports muscle protein synthesis, particularly when leucine content is sufficient, yet newer dose-comparison work suggests that more EAA is not always better for mixed-muscle synthesis once the response is already near maximal.
edges.caveats: The exact benefit depends on exercise mode, baseline protein intake, energy balance, and the comparison drink. Some recent studies show stronger whole-body protein-balance effects than direct mixed-muscle MPS differences.

evidence.citation: PasiakosSM et al 2011 Am J Clin Nutr
evidence.notes: Leucine-enriched essential amino acid supplementation during moderate steady state exercise enhances postexercise muscle protein synthesis.

effect_quant.comparator: leucine-enriched versus standard EAA for postexercise muscle protein synthesis

evidence.notes: Effects of high versus standard essential amino acid intakes on whole-body protein turnover and mixed muscle protein synthesis during energy deficit: A randomized, crossover study.

evidence.citation: McAdamJS et al 2021 J Int Soc Sports Nutr
evidence.notes: Essential amino acid-enriched whey enhances post-exercise whole-body protein balance during energy deficit more than iso-nitrogenous whey or a mixed-macronutrient meal: a randomized, crossover study.
